A large, hazardous '''asteroid field''' was located in the [[Krykas system/Legends|Krykas system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]]. The terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krykas V]] was situated in the middle of the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. At some point, the [[Guardian corvette|corvette]] ''[[Bhishana Bhaga]]'' reverted to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] in the middle of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field after its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] had malfunctioned. The [[Unidentified captain (Bhishana Bhaga)|captain]] of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] crash-landed the badly-damaged [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on Krykas V. Later, a group of individuals traversed the asteroid field to reach Krykas V in response to the crash of the ''Bhishana Bhaga''.

==Description==
A large [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]<ref name="Wizards" /> was located in the [[Krykas system/Legends|Krykas system]], a part of the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a thick area of spinning and crashing [[Color/Legends|gray]]-colored [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], with [[Starship/Legends|starship]] travel through it being very hazardous.<ref name="Wizards" />

==History==
At some point, the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of the ''[[Bhishana Bhaga]]'', a [[Guardian corvette|corvette]] carrying the [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and weapons [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Min Erethen]], malfunctioned. As a result, the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] emerged in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] in the middle of the Krykas [[Star system/Legends|system]] asteroid field. The vessel was badly damaged, and its [[Unidentified captain (Bhishana Bhaga)|captain]] attempted to save it by making an emergency landing on the only available [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the nearby [[Krykas V]]. The ship crash-landed there, with everyone aboard save Erethen being [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Wizards" />

Several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, a group of individuals arrived in-system in response to the crash of the ''Bhishana Bhaga''. The group traveled through the asteroid field, realizing that its starship had finally exited the area when a tiny asteroid bounced off the vessel's [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. At that point, the individuals had an unobstructed view of Krykas V, where they subsequently landed their ship. Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Nevo Faunor|Nevo]] and [[Irol Faunor]], a pair of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] hired by a company competing with Arakyd Industries to either retrieve or kill Erethen, also arrived on Krykas V.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Locations==
{{Main|Krykas V}}
The terrestrial planet Krykas V was located in the middle of the asteroid field and suffered regular asteroid hits on its surface as a result. A muddy world, Krykas V had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] filled with foggy clouds of [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetically]] charged particles that disrupted the operation of any [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Krykas V had no native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life-forms but was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to both [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and animals.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The asteroid field appeared in "[[Bloodhawk Down]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[October 10]], [[2002]].<ref name="Wizards" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Krykas system, and therefore the asteroid field, in grid square L-16.<ref name="TEA" />
